page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-8x.32xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance designed for high-density parallel computing workloads. It is powered by 128 dedicated Intel Xeon 8369B vCPUs operating at a base frequency of 2.9 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, providing a memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU.

The defining feature of this instance is its integrated graphics processing hardware, consisting of eight NVIDIA A10 GPUs with a combined video RAM of 192 GB. For high-throughput data transfers, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps. It runs on a KVM hypervisor.

A key architectural tradeoff of the ecs.gn7i-8x.32xlarge is the complete absence of local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the high density of eight GPUs paired with 128 dedicated vCPUs offers a consolidated platform for resource-intensive tasks, reducing the need to manage multiple smaller instances, though it requires careful orchestration of external storage to avoid network bottlenecks.

This hardware configuration is suited for workloads such as deep learning training, large-scale AI inference, high-performance video transcoding, 3D rendering pipelines, and complex scientific simulations that require massive parallel processing capabilities.
